news_headlines.title: Agentic AI's role in amplifying and creating insider risks
news_headlines.summary: Agentic AI is not only amplifying existing human insider risks, such as shadow AI and data leakage, but is also becoming an insider threat itself. Organizations are experiencing breaches from overprivileged AI agents acting autonomously and being manipulated by threat actors through methods like roundabout prompt injection. To mitigate these risks, organizations must implement strong AI policies, educate employees, enhance phishing prevention, integrate AI agents into identity management with least privilege principles, and continuously monitor both human and AI activities.

news_headlines.title: Why Super Micro Stock Is Falling Today

The company's co-founder pleaded not guilty to charges of diverting Nvidia-powered servers to China, and a class-action lawsuit claims concealed export law violations. Despite strong AI server demand, Super Micro's 8% gross profit margin remains a competitive weakness.

news_headlines.title: Mizuho cuts Super Micro Computer stock price target on near-term risks

The firm noted that legal issues involving the company's co-founder and alleged violations of U.S. export controls have led to a class-action lawsuit and further price target reductions from other analysts. Mizuho also raised its Dell estimates, citing potential order shifts.

news_headlines.title: Built for the Core: How AMD is Driving the 5G SA Era with High-Performant Data Center Infrastructure
news_headlines.summary: AMD is playing a crucial role in enabling the 5G Standalone (SA) era by providing high-performant data center infrastructure. The company's EPYC™ processors and Instinct™ GPUs offer powerful compute density, low latency processing, and high scalability essential for 5G core networks and advanced capabilities like network slicing. AMD also focuses on energy efficiency and an open ecosystem to support telcos in building future-ready and sustainable 5G networks.
